title: Assassin's Quest
author: Robin Hobb
summary: The final book of the Farseer trilogy follows FitzChivalry, a royal bastard trained as a secret assassin, as he sets off on a long and lonely journey. The Six Duchies face invasion and Fitz has little left to lose. Read the earlier books first.
readIf: you want a slow, deeply emotional fantasy ending that rewards investment in one character's long fall and recovery.
skipIf: you want a quick read or a standalone story, as it is long and relies heavily on the earlier books.

pairings.reason: Another slow, character-led epic fantasy about a young outsider who grows into something larger.
A fantasy of memory, loss and quiet heroism with a similarly emotional pull.
A grittier, funnier fantasy with an equally tortured protagonist.
